responsibility: Implements generic tree/GIMPLE data-flow utility routines shared across SSA middle-end passes. It renumbers statement UIDs, dumps variable and DFA statistics, provides base-object and constant-offset decomposition for references and addresses, detects and repairs uses of abnormal-phi SSA names, and emits declaration inventories for dumps, making it the common support layer for analyses and transforms that need stable statement numbering, alias-oriented reference decomposition, or SSA operand hygiene.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the executable tree/GIMPLE data-flow helper routines declared in gcc/tree-dfa.h, such as statement-UID renumbering, variable/DFA dumps, base-and-offset decomposition, abnormal-SSA repair, and declaration enumeration; the header only publishes these utilities.
